rules.name: combined-var-06-verify-operadb
rules.sql: SELECT current_database() AS db_name, inet_server_port() AS port, current_user AS db_user, now() AS db_time

SELECT business_unit, created_by, count(*) AS row_count, min(value_date) AS min_value_date, max(value_date) AS max_value_date, min(created_timestamp) AS first_written, max(created_timestamp) AS last_written FROM opera.helper_var_accounting_report GROUP BY business_unit, created_by ORDER BY business_unit, created_by

SELECT relname AS table_name, n_live_tup AS live_rows, n_tup_ins AS inserts_since_stats_reset, n_tup_upd AS updates, n_tup_del AS deletes, last_analyze, last_autoanalyze FROM pg_stat_user_tables WHERE schemaname = 'opera' AND relname IN ('helper_var_accounting_report', 'helper_var_mult_factor_view', 'var_aggregation_level_table', 'cloned_product_master_table') ORDER BY relname

WITH acct AS ( SELECT subportfolio, invenio_product_code, value_date FROM opera.helper_var_accounting_report WHERE LOWER(business_unit) = 'cfs' ), agg AS ( SELECT aggregation_level, subportfolio FROM opera.var_aggregation_level_table WHERE LOWER(business_unit) = 'cfs' AND UPPER(status) = 'ACTIVE' ) SELECT (SELECT count(DISTINCT aggregation_level) FROM agg) AS cfs_active_levels, (SELECT count(*) FROM acct) AS cfs_rows, (SELECT count(*) FROM acct WHERE subportfolio IN (SELECT subportfolio FROM agg)) AS cfs_rows_joined, (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.helper_var_accounting_report WHERE UPPER(business_unit) = 'USG') AS usg_rows, (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.helper_var_accounting_report WHERE UPPER(business_unit) = 'RMC') AS rmc_rows, (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.helper_var_mult_factor_view) AS mult_rows, (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT a.invenio_product_code, a.value_date FROM opera.helper_var_accounting_report a WHERE a.business_unit IN ('CFS', 'USG', 'RMC') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera.helper_var_mult_factor_view m WHERE m.invenio_product_code = a.invenio_product_code AND m.value_date = a.value_date)) x) AS accounting_pairs_without_multiplier

SELECT uuid, tenant_id, business_unit, value_date, settlement_date, subportfolio, p1_name, contract_month, vol_id, p1_settleprice, invenio_product_code, future_expiry, option_expiry, future_continuation_series, option_continuation_series, derivative_type, strike, delta, gamma, vega, theta, delta1, gamma1, vega1 FROM opera.helper_var_accounting_report WHERE business_unit IN ('CFS', 'USG')

SELECT uuid, tenant_id, business_unit, value_date, settlement_date, subportfolio, p1_name, contract_month, vol_id, p1_settleprice, invenio_product_code, future_expiry, option_expiry, future_continuation_series, option_continuation_series, derivative_type, strike, delta, gamma, vega, theta, delta1, gamma1, vega1 FROM opera.helper_var_accounting_report WHERE business_unit IN ('CFS', 'USG')
SELECT invenio_product_code, value_date, curr_mult, lot_mult, mult_factor FROM dbsystemuat.helper_var_mult_factor_view WHERE value_date IN (:vd1, :vd2)
SELECT invenio_product_code, value_date, curr_mult, lot_mult, mult_factor FROM opera.helper_var_mult_factor_view WHERE value_date IN (:vd1, :vd2)
